notes: Hillaire (2020) atmosphere parameters per body. SI units (m, 1/m); RGB channels are 680, 550 and 440 nm. The bottom radius is the body's equatorial radius; the ellipsoid is rendered in a space where it is a sphere.

bodies.source: Hillaire, A Scalable and Production Ready Sky and Atmosphere Rendering Technique, EGSR 2020

rayleigh.source: Earth Rayleigh x number-density ratio 0.00825 (610 Pa, 210 K) x CO2/air cross-section 2.48 (Sneep & Ubachs 2005)

mie.source: Dust tau 0.6 (MSL typical), single-scattering albedo 0.97/0.92/0.80 and stronger blue forward lobe after Wolff et al. 2009 and Lemmon et al. 2015 (blue sunset)

bodies.source: Hand-built dusty CO2 model tuned so the low-Sun sky near the Sun is blue (B/R > 1.1) and butterscotch away from it

rayleigh.source: CO2 at the ~70 km cloud tops (0.04 bar, 230 K): Earth Rayleigh x 0.049 x 2.48

mie.source: Upper sulfuric-acid haze, tau about 0.15, SSA 0.99 (approximate)

absorption.source: Unknown blue/UV absorber giving the yellow-white tint (approximate)

bodies.source: The rendered sphere is the cloud deck; this models only the haze above it

rayleigh.source: N2 at 1.5 bar, 94 K: Earth Rayleigh x number-density ratio 4.5

mie.source: Tholin haze, tau about 3-5, SSA 0.95/0.85/0.60 (approximate, after Tomasko et al. 2008)
